arguments.literal: The governed question is capability fit or a cost claim.
The activation declares its allowance and how spend will be measured.

The subject is frozen by identity before material reference exposure; the assessor records its expectations from the governing source before opening the candidate; it reads the subject at a named immutable identity, never a working tree; it makes no repair; it does not assess its own authorship.
Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.
The benchmark is the observable for the comparative baseline's criteria F27 and F28; F29 and F30 are the same observation reported with the task completed, the material errors detected and the cost.
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.
A claim names its subject, the property claimed, its basis, the relation between witness and claim, and its falsifier.

A claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated evidence; generalising a local observation needs a declared inference relation, the comparable population and explicit counterexample treatment.

Every clause in this corpus has exactly one standing relative to the rc.2 builder: conserved (the rc.2 clause governs unchanged; route given), reframed (obligation kept, restated at a different scope or owner; route and change given), superseded (an accepted successor replaces it; route and successor given) or new (no rc.2 clause states it; requiring principle given).
A work item closes by the condition it stated, not by a reviewer's approval; a reviewer result is an input to closure, never the closure.
Compute the material closure of the seed set under the relation family on the exact basis; if the closure is not finite and unique, the step returns a gap or refusal and does not guess.

A composite over several results declares its conjunction; the member it reports is chosen by that declared rule; every known failure and uncovered obligation survives the join and is carried with the composite; no universal order among the non-satisfied members exists.

For the context dimension the fit test is a measurement: the bytes of the selected context are measured before any read and compared with the declared cap; the measurement, the cap and the outcome are step-produced facts recorded before the read.

The core statement is the one-sentence route into the method: interpretation (FOUNDATIONS P1), purpose and contract (P2, SPEC_METHOD section 3), transformation under authority conserving material relations (P4a, P4b, CALCULUS sections 2 and 4), evaluation of claims (EVALUATION), continuation and recovery from current state (CALCULUS section 5).
Startup, framework, external computation, transport and assurance costs are separated so that one cannot conceal another; supported input dimensions and workloads are declared before qualification.
accept, local_repair, re_enter and reject are what the decision owner does with an assessed candidate; a disposition consumes a core result and is not one.
A valid parse, a valid map, a green test and a historical judgment each establish exactly their own claim.
A composite with a known failure or an uncovered required obligation cannot project success; a known failure A and an uncovered obligation B survive every join.
The selected context fits the envelope.
Activate.

If it does not fit, one or more of these, in combination: refine the outer contract into steps whose contexts fit; sequence activations; apply a lawful compression; select another actor whose envelope fits; or return out_of_frame.
The grant names the operations permitted, the territory that may change, and the decisions reserved to others.
Declared inputs are acquired by their exact identity; a declared input absent from the actor's materialised view is neither licence to read elsewhere nor evidence that it is absent.
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory.

The intake names: the selected outcome, admitted prerequisite or experiment it serves; the affected relation set and its invariants; the exact basis and the inputs it may acquire, each by identity and hash or by an input commit; the grant; the conditions that require re-entry at an owning relation; and, where the governed question is capability fit or a cost claim, the allowance and how spend will be measured.
Green labels, document counts, review counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance.

Semantic law defines what an evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; decision authority disposes; one actor may perform several and the record keeps them distinguishable.

A load-bearing claim names its exact subject, the property, the governing basis, the witness relation, the nearest weaker property it excludes, and its falsifier, before a witness is selected; without these it is evidence discovery, not proof.

The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else: a fresh competent constructor, inside a declared envelope, using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces and declared trial subjects, with material reference outcomes, incumbent realisations, author memory and ad hoc rescue withheld until freeze wherever earlier exposure would compromise reconstructive independence; then an independent evaluator compares the frozen result with the method's mandatory relation population.

Standing: conserves Method Self-Qualification, which leaves the constructor, freeze and assessor protocols to the governing authority, and RF-013 for reconstructability; the surfaces rule and the conditional withholding conserve UP-022's qualification protocol.

Where evidence is missing because a relation or capability needed to obtain it was not declared, the result is out_of_frame; indeterminate is reserved for the case where the declared capability was exercised and the admissible evidence still cannot decide.
A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.
A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.
A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation they serve.
Standing: independent. Identical capacity serves opposite purposes.
Judgments, residuals, observations and authority decisions the outer contract needs are recorded by the step that produced them.

Standing: derived; reframed from AC-009, AC-013, AC-005, UP-017 and UP-021, whose nine statements of conservation become one obligation with typed instances (authority, residual, judgment, frame, transition, successor claim, evidence by reference); each source clause continues to govern its own scope.

A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.
Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.
The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.
The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.
P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).
A document set that requires private validator knowledge, whole-corpus loading or a prior actor's memory fails the benchmark regardless of its content.

Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams; material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter because it exists.

A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy whose grant names its scope and exclusions; a proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Each clause names its requiring principle and, where it conserves, reframes or supersedes an rc.2 clause, that clause's route; a reader needing the rc.2 wording follows the route; the rc.2 cut remains the operative builder until STDO 3 is released.

For a selected activation, measure whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations with fidelity judged independently, and at what reconstruction cost (context transferred, time, and spend where measurable), against the rc.2 corpus as baseline.
Standing: new; derived from P0 with the actor-change premise.

A recoverability case gives a fresh actor only this corpus for a bounded activation on a declared subject, with the same task against the rc.2 corpus as baseline; a second case withholds validator folklore, author memory and whole-corpus loading, and the activation still succeeds or returns out_of_frame truthfully.
A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.
One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.
A review recommends a disposition; it does not apply one.

Standing: new (P0 with UP-014's selection rule).
A step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts (judgments with evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance) and one stop state from the result algebra.

A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.
For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

frame_indexes.scope: A fresh actor given only the published documents performs a bounded evaluation step: the route in, the intake, the measured fit, the five-member result with evidence, the separation of claim, evidence, judgment and authority, the stop state and the handoff; with reconstruction cost measured. Selected for the R-01 and R-02 cases.

residuals.detail: The envelope has four dimensions (context, attention, time, capability). The context dimension is measured in bytes before any read; attention, time and capability have no measure or declaration format, and the documents do not say how a step records that the test was performed on those dimensions.

Each independent commitment carries a one-sentence non-entailment argument in its qualification. These are claims of independence with an informal witness each; none is formalised and P4a states none. The accepted C1 realisation argues them at greater length; the standard conserves only the sentence.

Every encoded clause's rc.2 disposition is carried in the documents as a route, not in this program: the program's source basis is the tenant standards directory and rc.2 members are outside it. Conservation of an rc.2 clause therefore cannot be checked by this program's validation; it remains a semantic judgment over the documents and their routes.

symbols.label: Acceptance: the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject, exhausting only the instance and interval it names
Allowance: declared resource bound and spend measurement where capability fit or cost is the governed question
Independent assessment protocol: freeze, expectations, named identity, no repair, no own authorship
Authority: an identity-bearing permission to operate or to dispose acceptance within a scope
Basis: the exact immutable set of definitions a step, claim or result binds
Candidate: a step's output before evaluation
Change class: goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor, each with its re-entry point
Claim: an assertion with subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier
Standing of a corpus clause relative to the rc.2 builder: conserved, reframed, superseded or new
Closure condition: the condition a work item stated for its own closure
Constructor: the relation that produces the candidate and self-review

The method's core statement: interpret a scoped subject; select a purpose and governing contract; transform within admitted authority while conserving its material relations; evaluate the resulting claims; continue, recover or conclude from current state under explicit uncertainty
Cost categories kept separate: startup, framework, external computation, transport, assurance
Required obligation set R, admitted coverage C and uncovered coverage R minus C
Decision owner: the relation that disposes
Document map: the seven files, their tiers and what each owns
Envelope B: the actor's declared capability bound (context, attention, time, capability)
Evaluator: the relation that applies the declared relation between law and evidence
Evidence: artifacts, events, observations used to evaluate a claim on a basis
Falsifier: the observation that would defeat a claim, named before a witness is selected
Fit test of the selected context against the envelope
Grant: operations permitted, territory that may change, decisions reserved to others
Intake: the activation record from which a step's governing relations are reconstructed
Material closure of Z under R on the exact basis
The comparative baseline's criteria F27 to F30: native representation, onboarding, effectiveness evidence, work and resource measurement
Qualification of the method itself: a fresh constructor inside a declared envelope, then an independent evaluator against the mandatory relation population
Outcome U: a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval
P0 Bounded construction
P1 Interpretation
P2 Purpose
P3 Identity
P4a Typed composition
P4b Conservation of step-produced facts
P5 Totality
P6 Justification and authority
Proxy: an explicitly admitted bounded relation through which a human decision is exercised
falsified: a declared counterexample defeats it
indeterminate: admissible evidence cannot decide it
invalid_basis: the subject or basis cannot support the evaluation
out_of_frame: the evaluation needs an undeclared material relation or capability
satisfied: the declared predicate holds on the exact basis
The rc.2 builder corpus whose clauses this corpus conserves, reframes or supersedes
Reading route: for a stated purpose, the documents and sections to read in order

Recoverability benchmark: whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations, with fidelity judged independently and reconstruction cost measured against the rc.2 baseline
Recoverability case: a fresh actor given only this corpus, with private knowledge withheld
Refinement: ambiguity outcome (resolved, carried, escalated, blocked)
Refinement: construction availability (candidate_ready, refused, incomplete, re_entry_requested)
Refinement: disposition (accept, local_repair, re_enter, reject)
Refinement: profile-defined closure decisions
Relation family R: dependency relations whose change can alter the result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority
The one core result algebra for every evaluation and stop state
Review result: one core result per declared predicate with subject, basis, evidence, ranked findings, residual uncertainty, invalidation conditions and a recommended disposition
Seed set Z: subject, outcome and affected relations named in the intake
Selected context: the projection of the closure with its recorded boundary seams
Semantic law: what an evaluation means
Step: one bounded unit of work: intake, selected context, grant, execution, output
Step-produced fact: a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; a reproducible observation is not one
Stop state: the one core result a step returns
Witness: the evidence selected to support a claim under a declared relation
Work state: current persistent workspace, governing basis, applicable closed results and judgments with their invalidators, residuals, and known uncertainty over external effects
